relationships.subject: chondroitinase ABC
relationships.evidence_quote: numerous studies investigate the effects of chondroitinase ABC (ChABC) as a treatment after SCI in order to cleave CSPG

relationships.subject: reactive astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: reactive astrocytes secrete, among other molecules, chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan (CSPG) known to inhibit axonal regeneration

relationships.subject: Nogo-A
relationships.evidence_quote: myelin-enriched membrane protein Nogo-A has been identified as a major axonal regrowth inhibitor

relationships.subject: Rho pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: the Rho pathway has been described as inducing growth cone collapse after SCI

relationships.subject: Cethrin
relationships.evidence_quote: a Rho inhibitor such as Cethrin has been tested to promote axonal regrowth and functional recovery after SCI

key_findings: ChABC and anti-Nogo-A improve axonal regrowth and recovery in rodent SCI
The glial scar has dual permissive/inhibitory roles
